new_year_banquet.title: The New Year Banquet
new_year_banquet.description: The New Year approaches. Tradition demands the sect hold a grand banquet. Disciples look forward to this with great anticipation.

opt_lavish.text: Hold a grand banquet. Spare no expense.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] celebrated the New Year with a magnificent banquet. Morale soars.

opt_skip.text: Skip the festivities. Resources are scarce.

effects.text: I cancelled the New Year banquet. The disciples are unhappy.

tournament_invitation.title: An Invitation to the Grand Tournament
tournament_invitation.description: A sealed invitation arrives from a well-known regional sect, announcing the Great Martial Tournament of the Jianghu. First place commands legendary reputation.

opt_enter.text: Enter our best disciples. The Jianghu must know our strength.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] announced their participation in the Grand Tournament.

opt_decline.text: Decline. We are not yet ready to show our hand.

effects.text: I declined the tournament invitation. We will be ready when the time is right.

resource_windfall.title: An Unexpected Discovery
resource_windfall.description: While expanding the sect's training grounds, your disciples unearthed a cache of long-buried spiritual herbs — a windfall from a forgotten age.

opt_distribute.text: Distribute the herbs among the disciples equally.

opt_keep.text: Secure the herbs in the sect vault for strategic use.

building_completed_celebration.title: A New Foundation
building_completed_celebration.description: The construction is complete. The disciples gather to admire the new structure. This milestone deserves acknowledgment.

opt_ceremony.text: Hold an opening ceremony. Toast the builders.

opt_skip.text: No ceremonies. Get back to training.

effects.text: The building is done. No celebration — there is still work to be done.

stress_mental_strain.title: The Weight of Command
stress_mental_strain.description: [initiator_name] has been pushing themselves without rest. Their eyes are hollow, their movements erratic. Those closest to them speak of worry.

opt_take_rest.text: Enter brief seclusion. The sect can manage.

effects.text: I entered seclusion to restore my mind and spirit.

opt_push_through.text: Push through. Great leaders do not rest.

effects.text: I refused to rest. The fire in my chest will either forge me or consume me.
